build_manual_lr_schedule: build a ManualSchedule LR scheduler that decays learning rate on a manual epoch or update schedule
parse_manuallr_args: parse a dictionary string with epoch or update keys mapped to learning rate values
step_begin_epoch: update the optimizer learning rate at the beginning of a given training epoch
step_update: update the optimizer learning rate after each training update step
add_args: add epoch2lr and update2lr CLI arguments to an argparse parser for manual LR scheduling
